DALLAS, TX--(PR Newswire)--October 29, 2026--ATI Inc. (NYSE: ATI) reported third quarter 2026 results, with sales of $1.42 billion and net income attributable to ATI of $190 million, or $1.37 per share.

“We had a strong third quarter, exceeding the high-end of our guidance. We are raising our full-year outlook for adjusted EBITDA by $35 million. This follows the $125 million increase in our outlook just last quarter,” said Kimberly A. Fields, Board Chair, President and CEO. “Sales in the quarter grew 26% year-over-year, while adjusted EBITDA increased by 46% year-over-year. Our results reflect three main drivers: strong demand backed by long-term agreements, differentiated capabilities that make us the partner of choice, and disciplined execution across our operations.

“These results show the strength and balance of ATI’s portfolio and reinforce our growth outlook,” Fields continued. “We're delivering on our commitments and positioning ATI for even stronger performance in 2027.”

Third quarter 2026 GAAP earnings per share were $1.37 and adjusted earnings per share(a) were $1.46. Net income attributable to ATI was $189.8 million and ATI adjusted EBITDA(a) was $327.9 million, or 23.0% of sales. Third quarter 2026 adjusted results exclude pre-tax charges of $15.6 million for special items consisting of $14.4 million for restructuring and other charges and a $1.2 million debt extinguishment charge. The after-tax impact of these special items was a charge of $12.1 million, or $0.09 per share.

The third quarter 2026 restructuring and other charges include $8.4 million of transformation-related costs, $2.9 million of losses on the sale of customer accounts receivable, $2.2 million of start-up and transaction-related costs, and $0.9 million of restructuring-related costs.
